create_HummingConfig: create a HummingConfig quantization configuration for a vLLM model from a config dictionary
build_HummingLinearMethod: build a HummingLinearMethod to apply humming quantization to a linear layer
build_HummingMoEMethod: build a HummingMoEMethod to apply humming quantization to a fused MoE layer
test_HummingConfig_is_layer_skipped: test whether a layer is skipped by HummingConfig based on its prefix and config
get_HummingConfig_get_quant_method: get the quantization method for a layer from HummingConfig given the layer and prefix
